```{r setup}
# ======================================================================
# 01_plasma_decay_analysis_step1.Rmd
#
# RCTD plasma-cell proportion vs. distance from nerve, three groups,
# with shape-matched relocation sham comparator and per-nerve decay test.
#
# um_per_pixel loaded from the empirically calibrated value
# (um_per_pixel_CALIBRATED.rds), replacing the original, incorrect hardcoded
# PIXELS_PER_100UM = 46. See 00_scale_um_pixel_calibration.R.
#
# REVISION 1 (pseudoreplication):
#   - The 3 sham replicates per nerve are averaged into ONE geometry-matched
#     control per real nerve; each nerve is compared with its OWN control.
#   - Patient = independent replicate. PRIMARY: patient-level paired tests
#     (real vs own control; Friedman / paired t across groups), with effect
#     sizes and patient-level consistency. SENSITIVITY: nerve-level lm with
#     patient as a fixed block (optimistic: nerves within a patient are
#     still treated as independent).
#   - Distance-curve ribbons are SE across PATIENTS.
#
# REVISION 2 (second review):
#   - Far zone BOUNDED at 650-1000 um.
#   - Curve bins fixed: 6 x 150 um, 0-900 um (no folding of 750-1000 um).
#   - Decay is computed by ONE shared function (00_decay_shared.R) from the
#     cached distance table, the same function and table the all-cell-type
#     screen (step3) uses -- so step3's plasma row reproduces this script.
#   - Patient-level paired t-test actually computed (two-vector form);
#     test errors are printed, never swallowed.
#   - Bundle stores the decay settings; downstream scripts refuse to run on
#     a bundle built with different settings.
#
# Directory layout:
#   shared code -> scripts/00_decay_shared.R
#   inputs      -> input/
#   tables      -> output/<ANALYSIS_NAME>/tables/
#   figures     -> output/<ANALYSIS_NAME>/figures/
#   .rds        -> processed/
# ======================================================================

library(SpatialExperiment)
library(RANN)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r config_and_load}
count     <- dplyr::count
rename    <- dplyr::rename
summarise <- dplyr::summarise

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
ANALYSIS_NAME <- "01_plasma_cells"

INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")

dir.create(FIGURES_DIR,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_dir <- list(tables = TABLES_DIR, figures = FIGURES_DIR, processed = PROCESSED_DIR)

# ---- 0a. Shared code: zones, binning, groups, decay, tests -------------
SHARED_PATH <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "scripts", "00_decay_shared.R")

source(SHARED_PATH)
cat("Near zone: <=", NEAR_CUTOFF_UM, "um | far zone:", FAR_MIN_UM, "-", FAR_MAX_UM,
    "um | curve bins:", paste(head(bin_breaks, -1), bin_breaks[-1], sep = "-", collapse = ", "), "um\n")

# ---- 0b. Load spe + RCTD weights --------------------------------------
# Place into input/ before running:
#   Integrated_NMF.rds, DE_SPE_annotaion.csv, RCTD_weights.Rds
spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))

colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode
coords <- spatialCoords(spe)

W_df <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "RCTD_weights.Rds"))
stopifnot("B_cells_(Plasma_cells)" %in% colnames(W_df))

SCORE_COLUMN   <- "B_cells_(Plasma_cells)"
SIGNATURE_NAME <- "RCTD_PlasmaCells"

plasma_score <- setNames(W_df[[SCORE_COLUMN]], W_df$barcode)
cat("Score source:", SCORE_COLUMN, "| spots with a score:", sum(!is.na(plasma_score)), "\n")

# ---- 1. Distance/pixel conversion -------------------------------------
UM_PER_PIXEL_PATH <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "um_per_pixel_CALIBRATED.rds")
if (!file.exists(UM_PER_PIXEL_PATH)) {
  stop("Calibrated um_per_pixel not found. Run um_per_pixel_calibration.R first.")
}
um_per_pixel <- readRDS(UM_PER_PIXEL_PATH)
cat("Loaded calibrated um_per_pixel:", round(um_per_pixel, 6),
    "(PIXELS_PER_100UM equivalent:", round(100 / um_per_pixel, 3), ")\n")
```

```{r real_nerve_distances_and_curves}
# ---- 2. Nerves and their groups ---------------------------------------
stopifnot("patient_id" %in% colnames(colData(spe)))

is_nerve <- !is.na(spe$NerveID)
nerve_info <- unique(data.frame(
  NerveID    = spe$NerveID[is_nerve],
  sample_id  = spe$sample_id[is_nerve],
  patient_id = spe$patient_id[is_nerve],
  context    = spe$context[is_nerve],
  Invaded    = spe$Invaded[is_nerve]
))
nerve_info <- nerve_info[!is.na(nerve_info$NerveID), ]
nerve_info$NerveID <- as.character(nerve_info$NerveID)   # character throughout
cat("Total individual nerves:", nrow(nerve_info), "\n")
cat("Unique sample_id:", n_distinct(nerve_info$sample_id),
    "| Unique patient_id:", n_distinct(nerve_info$patient_id), "\n")
print(table(nerve_info$context, nerve_info$Invaded))

nerve_groups <- nerve_groups_from_info(nerve_info)   # GROUP_DEFS from shared file
print(table(nerve_groups$Group, nerve_groups$patient_id))

# ---- 3. Per-nerve distance cache (out to DIST_CACHE_MAX_UM) -----------
# Query = all non-nerve spots in the nerve's own section. This one table
# feeds the distance curves AND the near/far decay, here and in step3.
compute_per_nerve_distances <- function(nerve_ids, spe, coords, max_dist_um, um_per_pixel) {
  max_dist_px <- max_dist_um / um_per_pixel
  results <- vector("list", length(nerve_ids))
  for (i in seq_along(nerve_ids)) {
    nid <- nerve_ids[i]
    smp <- unique(spe$sample_id[spe$NerveID == nid & !is.na(spe$NerveID)])
    if (length(smp) != 1) next
    idx_this_nerve <- which(spe$sample_id == smp & !is.na(spe$NerveID) & spe$NerveID == nid)
    idx_query      <- which(spe$sample_id == smp & is.na(spe$NerveID))
    if (length(idx_this_nerve) == 0 || length(idx_query) == 0) next
    nn <- nn2(coords[idx_this_nerve, , drop = FALSE], coords[idx_query, , drop = FALSE],
              k = 1, searchtype = "radius", radius = max_dist_px)
    valid <- nn$nn.dists[, 1] <= max_dist_px & nn$nn.dists[, 1] >= 0
    if (sum(valid) == 0) next
    results[[i]] <- data.frame(NerveID = nid, barcode = spe$barcode[idx_query[valid]],
                               dist_px = nn$nn.dists[valid, 1])
  }
  out <- do.call(rbind, results)
  out$dist_um <- out$dist_px * um_per_pixel
  out
}

cat("Computing per-nerve distances (out to", DIST_CACHE_MAX_UM, "um)...\n")
per_nerve_dist_all <- compute_per_nerve_distances(nerve_info$NerveID, spe, coords, DIST_CACHE_MAX_UM, um_per_pixel)
per_nerve_dist_all$NerveID <- as.character(per_nerve_dist_all$NerveID)
per_nerve_dist_all$bin   <- bin_mid(per_nerve_dist_all$dist_um)   # NA beyond CURVE_MAX_UM
per_nerve_dist_all$score <- plasma_score[per_nerve_dist_all$barcode]
cat("Total (nerve, spot) pairs:", nrow(per_nerve_dist_all), "\n")

# ---- 4. Per-nerve curves ----------------------------------------------
# Nerve-level only; group curves are averaged at the PATIENT level in
# section 8, after pairing with the relocated controls.
nerve_spot_idx <- which(!is.na(spe$NerveID) & as.character(spe$NerveID) %in% nerve_groups$NerveID)
anchor_per_nerve <- data.frame(NerveID = as.character(spe$NerveID[nerve_spot_idx]),
                               score   = plasma_score[spe$barcode[nerve_spot_idx]]) %>%
  group_by(NerveID) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), n_spots = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(bin = 0)

per_nerve_all <- bind_rows(
  anchor_per_nerve,
  per_nerve_dist_all %>%
    filter(NerveID %in% nerve_groups$NerveID, !is.na(bin)) %>%   # curve range only
    group_by(NerveID, bin) %>%
    summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), n_spots = n(), .groups = "drop")
) %>%
  left_join(nerve_groups %>% select(NerveID, Group), by = "NerveID") %>%
  mutate(Group = as.character(Group)) %>%
  arrange(Group, NerveID, bin)

for (g in group_levels) cat(g, "-- nerves:", sum(nerve_groups$Group == g), "\n")
write.csv(per_nerve_all, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("per_nerve_curves_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r sham_generation}
# ---- 5. Shape-preserving relocation sham ------------------------------
set.seed(42)
N_SHAM_REPLICATES      <- 3     # averaged per nerve downstream -> not extra n
MAX_PLACEMENT_TRIES    <- 100
MIN_SNAP_FRAC          <- 0.9
MIN_RELOCATION_DIST_UM <- 300

compute_spot_spacing <- function(spe, coords, smp) {
  idx <- which(spe$sample_id == smp)
  if (length(idx) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  nn <- nn2(coords[idx, , drop = FALSE], coords[idx, , drop = FALSE], k = 2)
  median(nn$nn.dists[, 2])
}
sample_ids_all <- unique(spe$sample_id)
spot_spacing_by_sample <- setNames(sapply(sample_ids_all, function(s) compute_spot_spacing(spe, coords, s)), sample_ids_all)

relocate_nerve_shape <- function(nerve_id, replicate_idx, spe, coords, um_per_pixel, spot_spacing_by_sample,
                                 max_tries = MAX_PLACEMENT_TRIES, min_snap_frac = MIN_SNAP_FRAC,
                                 min_reloc_dist_um = MIN_RELOCATION_DIST_UM) {
  smp <- unique(spe$sample_id[spe$NerveID == nerve_id & !is.na(spe$NerveID)])
  if (length(smp) != 1) return(NULL)
  nerve_idx <- which(spe$sample_id == smp & !is.na(spe$NerveID) & spe$NerveID == nerve_id)
  if (length(nerve_idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  nerve_coords <- coords[nerve_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  centroid <- colMeans(nerve_coords)
  rel_coords <- sweep(nerve_coords, 2, centroid, "-")
  sample_idx <- which(spe$sample_id == smp)
  sample_coords <- coords[sample_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  sample_barcodes <- spe$barcode[sample_idx]
  is_real_nerve_spot <- !is.na(spe$NerveID[sample_idx])
  spacing <- spot_spacing_by_sample[[smp]]
  if (is.na(spacing)) return(NULL)
  snap_tol_px <- 0.6 * spacing
  min_reloc_dist_px <- min_reloc_dist_um / um_per_pixel
  for (try_i in seq_len(max_tries)) {
    candidate_centroid_idx <- sample(seq_along(sample_idx), 1)
    candidate_centroid <- sample_coords[candidate_centroid_idx, ]
    dist_from_original <- sqrt(sum((candidate_centroid - centroid)^2))
    if (dist_from_original < min_reloc_dist_px) next
    translated <- sweep(rel_coords, 2, candidate_centroid, "+")
    nn <- nn2(sample_coords, translated, k = 1)
    snap_dist <- nn$nn.dists[, 1]
    snap_idx  <- nn$nn.idx[, 1]
    snapped_ok <- snap_dist <= snap_tol_px
    if (mean(snapped_ok) < min_snap_frac) next
    used_idx <- snap_idx[snapped_ok]
    if (any(duplicated(used_idx))) next
    if (any(is_real_nerve_spot[used_idx])) next
    return(data.frame(
      ShamNerveID = paste0("sham_", nerve_id, "_rep", replicate_idx),
      source_NerveID = as.character(nerve_id), sample_id = smp,
      barcode = sample_barcodes[used_idx], stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  NULL
}

cat("\nGenerating shape-matched relocation shams (", N_SHAM_REPLICATES, " replicates per nerve)...\n", sep = "")
sham_shapes <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(nerve_info))) {
  nid <- nerve_info$NerveID[i]
  for (r in seq_len(N_SHAM_REPLICATES)) {
    sham_shapes[[paste0(nid, "_rep", r)]] <- relocate_nerve_shape(nid, r, spe, coords, um_per_pixel, spot_spacing_by_sample)
  }
}
n_failed <- sum(sapply(sham_shapes, is.null))
cat("Placement attempts:", length(sham_shapes), "| failed:", n_failed, "\n")
sham_shapes_df <- bind_rows(sham_shapes) %>%
  left_join(nerve_info %>% select(NerveID, context, Invaded), by = c("source_NerveID" = "NerveID"))

compute_per_shape_distances <- function(sham_shapes_df, spe, coords, max_dist_um, um_per_pixel) {
  max_dist_px <- max_dist_um / um_per_pixel
  shape_ids <- unique(sham_shapes_df$ShamNerveID)
  results <- vector("list", length(shape_ids))
  for (i in seq_along(shape_ids)) {
    sid <- shape_ids[i]
    shape_rows <- sham_shapes_df[sham_shapes_df$ShamNerveID == sid, ]
    smp <- shape_rows$sample_id[1]
    anchor_idx <- which(spe$barcode %in% shape_rows$barcode)
    idx_query <- which(spe$sample_id == smp & is.na(spe$NerveID) & !(spe$barcode %in% shape_rows$barcode))
    if (length(anchor_idx) == 0 || length(idx_query) == 0) next
    nn <- nn2(coords[anchor_idx, , drop = FALSE], coords[idx_query, , drop = FALSE],
              k = 1, searchtype = "radius", radius = max_dist_px)
    valid <- nn$nn.dists[, 1] <= max_dist_px & nn$nn.dists[, 1] >= 0
    if (sum(valid) == 0) next
    results[[i]] <- data.frame(ShamNerveID = sid, barcode = spe$barcode[idx_query[valid]],
                               dist_px = nn$nn.dists[valid, 1])
  }
  out <- do.call(rbind, results)
  out$dist_um <- out$dist_px * um_per_pixel
  out
}

cat("Computing distances from relocated sham shapes (out to", DIST_CACHE_MAX_UM, "um)...\n")
per_shape_dist_all <- compute_per_shape_distances(sham_shapes_df, spe, coords, DIST_CACHE_MAX_UM, um_per_pixel)
per_shape_dist_all$bin   <- bin_mid(per_shape_dist_all$dist_um)   # NA beyond CURVE_MAX_UM
per_shape_dist_all$score <- plasma_score[per_shape_dist_all$barcode]

# Per-replicate curves; averaged per source nerve in section 8
shape_map <- distinct(sham_shapes_df, ShamNerveID, source_NerveID) %>%
  left_join(nerve_groups %>% select(NerveID, Group), by = c("source_NerveID" = "NerveID")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group))

sham_per_shape_all <- bind_rows(
  sham_shapes_df %>%
    filter(ShamNerveID %in% shape_map$ShamNerveID) %>%
    mutate(score = plasma_score[barcode]) %>%
    group_by(ShamNerveID) %>%
    summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), n_spots = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(bin = 0),
  per_shape_dist_all %>%
    filter(ShamNerveID %in% shape_map$ShamNerveID, !is.na(bin)) %>%   # curve range only
    group_by(ShamNerveID, bin) %>%
    summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), n_spots = n(), .groups = "drop")
) %>%
  left_join(shape_map, by = "ShamNerveID") %>%
  mutate(Group = as.character(Group)) %>%
  arrange(Group, ShamNerveID, bin)

for (g in group_levels) cat("Sham:", g, "-- relocated shapes:", sum(shape_map$Group == g), "\n")

write.csv(sham_shapes_df,     file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("sham_shapes_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sham_per_shape_all, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("sham_per_shape_curves_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r decay_magnitude}
# ---- 6. Per-nerve near-vs-far decay magnitude -------------------------
# Computed by the shared decay_table() from the cached distance tables:
#   near = <= 150 um, far = 650-1000 um, >= 3 spots in each zone.
# step3 calls the same function on the same tables for every cell type.
decay_all      <- real_decay_table(per_nerve_dist_all, plasma_score, nerve_groups)
sham_decay_all <- sham_decay_table(per_shape_dist_all, plasma_score, sham_shapes_df)   # one row per REPLICATE

write.csv(decay_all,      file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("decay_magnitude_real_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sham_decay_all, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("decay_magnitude_sham_replicates_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nReal nerves with usable near+far data, per group x patient:\n")
print(table(decay_all$Group, decay_all$patient_id))
```

```{r pairing_and_stats}
# ---- 7. Pair each real nerve with its own control ---------------------
sd_all_spots <- sd(plasma_score, na.rm = TRUE)   # for standardised enrichment

paired_nerve <- pair_real_with_controls(decay_all, sham_decay_all)

cat("Real nerves with usable near/far data:", nrow(decay_all), "\n")
cat("  ...paired with >=1 valid relocated control:", nrow(paired_nerve),
    "| excluded (report in Methods):", nrow(decay_all) - nrow(paired_nerve), "\n")
cat("\nPaired nerves per group x patient:\n")
print(table(paired_nerve$Group, paired_nerve$patient_id))
cat("\nSuccessful sham replicates per nerve:\n")
print(table(n_sham_reps = paired_nerve$n_sham_reps))
write.csv(paired_nerve, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("paired_nerve_real_vs_sham_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

paired_patient <- summarise_by_patient(paired_nerve)
write.csv(paired_patient, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("paired_patient_level_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 7d. Real vs. own control, per group ------------------------------
# Inferential hierarchy (patient = independent biological replicate):
#   PRIMARY     patient-level paired t-test, real vs. own control
#               (n = patients with both, df = n - 1); effect size = mean of
#               patient means; consistency = patients with a positive effect.
#   SENSITIVITY nerve-level lm with patient as fixed block (nerve_*). Its
#               estimate equals the mean of patient means, but its p-value
#               treats nerves within a patient as independent, so it is
#               optimistic and is reported as secondary only.
outcome_cols <- list(delta_decay = c("decay_magnitude", "sham_decay"),
                     delta_near  = c("near_score",      "sham_near"),
                     delta_far   = c("far_score",       "sham_far"))

real_vs_sham <- bind_rows(lapply(group_levels, function(g) {
  sub <- paired_nerve   %>% filter(Group == g)
  pat <- paired_patient %>% filter(Group == g)
  bind_rows(lapply(names(outcome_cols), function(outc) {
    pt <- patient_paired_t(pat, outcome_cols[[outc]][1], outcome_cols[[outc]][2],
                           paste(short_labels[[g]], outc))
    bt <- block_intercept_test(sub, outc)
    data.frame(Group = short_labels[[g]], outcome = outc,
               # primary: patient level
               n_patients = pt$n_patients_paired,
               effect = pt$patient_mean_diff,
               n_patients_positive = sum(pat[[outc]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
               patient_t = pt$patient_t, patient_df = pt$patient_df, patient_p = pt$patient_p,
               patient_note = pt$patient_note,
               # sensitivity: nerve level, patient as fixed block
               n_nerves = bt$n_nerves, nerve_estimate = bt$estimate, nerve_se = bt$se,
               nerve_df = bt$df_resid, nerve_p = bt$p_value)
  }))
}))
real_vs_sham$effect_std <- ifelse(real_vs_sham$outcome == "delta_decay",
                                  real_vs_sham$effect / sd_all_spots, NA_real_)

cat("\n=== Sham-corrected enrichment per group (real - own control) ===\n")
cat("PRIMARY (patient level): effect = mean of patient means; patient_p = paired t, df = n_patients - 1;\n")
cat("  n_patients_positive = patients whose mean effect is > 0.\n")
cat("SENSITIVITY (nerve level): nerve_* = lm with patient as fixed block (optimistic p-value).\n")
print(real_vs_sham, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
if (any(real_vs_sham$patient_note != "")) {
  cat("\nNOTE -- patient-level test not computed for:\n")
  print(real_vs_sham %>% filter(patient_note != "") %>% select(Group, outcome, patient_note), row.names = FALSE)
}
write.csv(real_vs_sham, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("real_vs_own_sham_blocked_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nPer-patient mean paired differences (descriptive):\n")
print(paired_patient %>% mutate(Group = short_labels[as.character(Group)]) %>%
        select(Group, patient_id, n_nerves, delta_decay, delta_near, delta_far), digits = 3)

# ---- 7e. Figures: real nerves, and real vs. own control ---------------
zone_label <- paste0("Decay = near(<=", NEAR_CUTOFF_UM, "µm) minus far(", FAR_MIN_UM, "-", FAR_MAX_UM, "µm)")

p_decay <- ggplot(decay_all, aes(x = Group, y = decay_magnitude, color = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = factor(patient_id)), width = 0.15, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Invaded nerves (Diseased)" = "#F8766D",
                                "Non-invaded nerves (Diseased)" = "#00BA38",
                                "Non-invaded nerves (Adjacent)" = "#619CFF")) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Patient", values = c(15, 16, 17, 18, 3, 4)) +
  labs(title = paste0("Per-nerve decay magnitude: ", SCORE_COLUMN),
       subtitle = paste0("Each point = one nerve, shape = patient. ", zone_label),
       x = NULL, y = "Decay magnitude (near - far)") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
print(p_decay)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("per_nerve_decay_boxplot_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".pdf")), p_decay, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 600)

decay_plot_long <- paired_nerve %>%
  select(NerveID, Group, patient_id, Real = decay_magnitude, Sham = sham_decay) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Real, Sham), names_to = "Source", values_to = "decay_magnitude") %>%
  mutate(Source = factor(Source, levels = c("Real", "Sham")),
         GroupBase = factor(short_labels[as.character(Group)], levels = short_labels))

p_decay_paired <- ggplot(decay_plot_long, aes(x = Source, y = decay_magnitude)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(group = NerveID), color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = Source), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.25, width = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Source, shape = patient_id), size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ GroupBase, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Real = "#D55E00", Sham = "grey50"), guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Patient", values = c(15, 16, 17, 18, 3, 4, 8, 5)) +
  labs(title = paste0("Real nerve vs. own geometry-matched control: ", SCORE_COLUMN),
       subtitle = paste0("Lines join each nerve to the mean of its relocated replicates. ", zone_label),
       x = NULL, y = "Decay magnitude (near - far)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(p_decay_paired)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("decay_paired_real_vs_sham_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".pdf")),
       p_decay_paired, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 600)

# ---- 7f. Does enrichment differ across nerve groups? ------------------
net_effect <- paired_patient %>%
  transmute(GroupBase  = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels),
            patient_id = as.character(patient_id),
            Real = decay_magnitude, Sham = sham_decay, net_effect = delta_decay)
write.csv(net_effect, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("net_effect_per_patient_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

complete_patients <- net_effect %>% group_by(patient_id) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(GroupBase) == length(group_levels)) %>% pull(patient_id) %>% unique()
net_effect_complete <- net_effect %>% filter(patient_id %in% complete_patients)
cat("\nPatients with all three nerve groups:", length(complete_patients), "\n")

# (a) PRIMARY, patient level: Friedman + pairwise paired t (Holm)
friedman_res <- NULL
if (length(complete_patients) >= 2) {
  friedman_mat <- net_effect_complete %>% select(patient_id, GroupBase, net_effect) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = GroupBase, values_from = net_effect) %>%
    select(all_of(group_levels)) %>% as.matrix()
  friedman_res <- tryCatch(friedman.test(friedman_mat), error = function(e) {
    message("Friedman test FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (!is.null(friedman_res)) print(friedman_res)
  cat("Note: with 3 patients x 3 groups the smallest attainable p (chi-square approx.) is 0.0498.\n")
}

pairwise_patient <- bind_rows(lapply(combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(p) {
  wide <- net_effect_complete %>% filter(GroupBase %in% p) %>%
    select(GroupBase, patient_id, net_effect) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = GroupBase, values_from = net_effect) %>% na.omit()
  res <- data.frame(group1 = short_labels[[p[1]]], group2 = short_labels[[p[2]]],
                    n_patients = nrow(wide), mean_diff = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_)
  if (nrow(wide) >= 2) {
    tt <- tryCatch(t.test(wide[[p[1]]], wide[[p[2]]], paired = TRUE), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(tt, "error")) {
      message("Pairwise patient t-test FAILED (", res$group1, " vs ", res$group2, "): ", conditionMessage(tt))
    } else {
      res$mean_diff <- unname(tt$estimate); res$p_value <- tt$p.value
    }
  } else {
    message("Pairwise patient t-test skipped (", res$group1, " vs ", res$group2, "): fewer than 2 patients")
  }
  res
}))
pairwise_patient$p_holm <- p.adjust(pairwise_patient$p_value, method = "holm")
cat("\n=== PRIMARY: pairwise, patient level (paired t, Holm) ===\n")
print(pairwise_patient, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)

# (b) SENSITIVITY, nerve level: lm(delta ~ Group + patient), Holm
pairwise_nerve <- bind_rows(lapply(combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(p)
  block_group_test(paired_nerve, p[1], p[2], "delta_decay")))
pairwise_nerve$p_holm <- p.adjust(pairwise_nerve$p_value, method = "holm")
cat("\n=== SENSITIVITY: pairwise, nerve level (lm with patient as fixed block, Holm) ===\n")
print(pairwise_nerve, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)

group_comparison <- pairwise_patient %>% mutate(role = "primary", level = "patient (paired t)")
if (!is.null(friedman_res)) {
  group_comparison <- bind_rows(group_comparison,
    data.frame(group1 = "all", group2 = "all", n_patients = length(complete_patients),
               mean_diff = NA_real_, p_value = friedman_res$p.value, p_holm = NA_real_,
               role = "primary", level = "patient (Friedman)"))
}
group_comparison <- bind_rows(group_comparison,
  pairwise_nerve %>% transmute(group1, group2, n_patients = n_patients_both_groups,
                               mean_diff = estimate, p_value, p_holm,
                               role = "sensitivity", level = "nerve (lm + patient block)"))
write.csv(group_comparison, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("group_comparison_net_effect_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Per-patient enrichment per nerve category, with statistics
#   points    = one patient's mean sham-corrected enrichment (real - own control)
#   bar       = mean of the patient means (the reported effect size)
#   above     = within-category test: patients with positive enrichment and
#               patient-level paired t-test p (real vs own control, df = n - 1)
#   brackets  = between-category pairwise paired t-tests on patient means,
#               Holm-adjusted (primary analysis); Friedman p in the caption
if (!exists("pdf_device")) pdf_device <- if (isTRUE(capabilities("cairo"))) grDevices::cairo_pdf else grDevices::pdf
# Standalone use: if the statistics objects are not in the session, read the
# tables step1 already saved (needs TABLES_DIR, FIGURES_DIR, SIGNATURE_NAME).
if (!exists("SIGNATURE_NAME")) SIGNATURE_NAME <- "RCTD_PlasmaCells"
if (!exists("TABLES_DIR") || !exists("FIGURES_DIR")) {
  TABLES_DIR  <- file.path("output", "01_plasma_cells", "tables")
  FIGURES_DIR <- file.path("output", "01_plasma_cells", "figures")
}
if (!exists("short_labels")) short_labels <- c("Invaded nerves (Diseased)" = "InvN",
                                               "Non-invaded nerves (Diseased)" = "NI-TB",
                                               "Non-invaded nerves (Adjacent)" = "NI-Adj")
if (!exists("net_effect"))
  net_effect <- read.csv(file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("net_effect_per_patient_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv"))) %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id))
if (!exists("real_vs_sham"))
  real_vs_sham <- read.csv(file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("real_vs_own_sham_blocked_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")))
if (!exists("pairwise_patient") || !exists("friedman_res")) {
  gc_tab <- read.csv(file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("group_comparison_net_effect_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")))
  pairwise_patient <- gc_tab %>% filter(level == "patient (paired t)")
  fr <- gc_tab %>% filter(level == "patient (Friedman)")
  friedman_res <- if (nrow(fr) == 1) list(p.value = fr$p_value) else NULL
}
net_effect$patient_id <- factor(net_effect$patient_id)

format_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", formatC(p, digits = 2, format = "g")))

manuscript_order  <- c("Non-invaded nerves (Adjacent)", "Non-invaded nerves (Diseased)", "Invaded nerves (Diseased)")
manuscript_labels <- c("NI (adjacent)", "NI (tumour-bearing)", "InvN")
short_in_order    <- unname(short_labels[manuscript_order])          # "NI-Adj", "NI-TB", "InvN"

ranking_plot_df <- net_effect %>%
  mutate(GroupBase = factor(as.character(GroupBase), levels = manuscript_order, labels = manuscript_labels))
cat_means <- ranking_plot_df %>% group_by(GroupBase) %>% summarise(m = mean(net_effect), .groups = "drop")

y_all <- c(0, ranking_plot_df$net_effect)
y_top <- max(y_all, na.rm = TRUE); y_rng <- diff(range(y_all, na.rm = TRUE))

within_lab <- real_vs_sham %>% filter(outcome == "delta_decay") %>%
  transmute(GroupBase = factor(manuscript_labels[match(Group, short_in_order)], levels = manuscript_labels),
            label = sprintf("%d/%d patients > 0\np = %s", n_patients_positive, n_patients, format_p(patient_p)),
            y = y_top + 0.12 * y_rng)

brackets <- pairwise_patient %>%
  mutate(x1 = match(group1, short_in_order), x2 = match(group2, short_in_order),
         xa = pmin(x1, x2), xb = pmax(x1, x2), span = xb - xa) %>%
  arrange(span, xa) %>%
  mutate(y = y_top + (0.38 + 0.16 * (row_number() - 1)) * y_rng,
         label = paste0("p = ", format_p(p_holm)))

p_ranking <- ggplot(ranking_plot_df, aes(x = GroupBase, y = net_effect)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(data = cat_means, aes(x = GroupBase, ymin = m, ymax = m), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                width = 0.4, linewidth = 0.8, color = "grey20") +
  geom_point(aes(color = patient_id, shape = patient_id), size = 3,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_text(data = within_lab, aes(x = GroupBase, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 3, lineheight = 0.9, vjust = 0) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = xa, xend = xb, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = xa, xend = xa, y = y, yend = y - 0.03 * y_rng), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = xb, xend = xb, y = y, yend = y - 0.03 * y_rng), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = brackets, aes(x = (xa + xb) / 2, y = y + 0.015 * y_rng, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 3, vjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.08))) +
  labs(title = "Sham-corrected near-nerve enrichment, per patient",
       x = NULL, y = "Enrichment (patient mean of real - own control)",
       color = "Patient", shape = "Patient",
       caption = paste0("Points: patient means; bar: mean of patients.\n",
                        "Above each category: patients with positive enrichment; paired t-test vs own control.\n",
                        "Brackets: pairwise paired t-tests between categories, Holm-adjusted",
                        if (!is.null(friedman_res)) paste0("; Friedman test p = ", format_p(friedman_res$p.value)) else "",
                        ". n = ", n_distinct(ranking_plot_df$patient_id), " patients.")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8))
print(p_ranking)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("per_patient_ranking_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".pdf")),
       p_ranking, width = 6.5, height = 6, dpi = 600, device = pdf_device)
```

```{r patient_level_curves}
# ---- 8. Distance curves with PATIENT-level uncertainty ----------------
# nerve curve -> (sham replicates averaged per source nerve) -> patient mean
# curve -> mean +/- SE across patients. Only nerves with both a real and a
# control curve are used, so both lines describe the same nerves/patients.
real_curve_nerve <- per_nerve_all %>%
  transmute(source = "Real", Group, NerveID = as.character(NerveID), bin, mean_score)

sham_curve_nerve <- sham_per_shape_all %>%
  group_by(Group, NerveID = as.character(source_NerveID), bin) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "Sham")

paired_ids <- intersect(real_curve_nerve$NerveID, sham_curve_nerve$NerveID)

patient_curves <- bind_rows(real_curve_nerve, sham_curve_nerve) %>%
  filter(NerveID %in% paired_ids) %>%
  left_join(nerve_groups %>% select(NerveID, patient_id), by = "NerveID") %>%
  group_by(source, Group, patient_id, bin) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE), n_nerves = n(), .groups = "drop")

averaged_patient_level <- patient_curves %>%
  group_by(source, Group, bin) %>%
  summarise(mean_across_patients = mean(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE),
            se         = sd(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(mean_score))),
            n_patients = sum(is.finite(mean_score)),
            n_nerves   = sum(n_nerves), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(patient_curves,         file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("patient_curves_real_and_sham_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(averaged_patient_level, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("averaged_curves_patient_level_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r validate_and_save_bundle}
# ---- 9. Validate and save bundle for downstream scripts ---------------
required_objects <- c("spe", "coords", "plasma_score", "sham_shapes_df", "nerve_info", "nerve_groups",
                      "decay_all", "sham_decay_all", "paired_nerve", "paired_patient", "real_vs_sham",
                      "um_per_pixel", "per_nerve_dist_all", "per_shape_dist_all", "out_dir")
missing_objects <- required_objects[!sapply(required_objects, exists)]
if (length(missing_objects) > 0) stop("Cannot save bundle -- missing: ", paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "))

validation_errors <- c()
if (!"NerveID" %in% colnames(colData(spe)))   validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "spe is missing NerveID column")
if (nrow(sham_shapes_df) == 0)                 validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "sham_shapes_df is empty")
if (nrow(paired_nerve) == 0)                   validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "paired_nerve is empty")
if (!"patient_id" %in% colnames(decay_all))    validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "decay_all is missing patient_id")
if (!is.character(decay_all$NerveID))          validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "decay_all$NerveID is not character")
if (!is.character(nerve_info$NerveID))         validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "nerve_info$NerveID is not character")
if (nrow(per_nerve_dist_all) == 0)             validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "per_nerve_dist_all is empty")
if (nrow(per_shape_dist_all) == 0)             validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "per_shape_dist_all is empty")
if (max(per_nerve_dist_all$dist_um) > DIST_CACHE_MAX_UM + 1e-6)
  validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "per_nerve_dist_all exceeds DIST_CACHE_MAX_UM")
if (!is.numeric(um_per_pixel) || um_per_pixel <= 0) validation_errors <- c(validation_errors, "um_per_pixel invalid")
if (length(validation_errors) > 0) stop("Bundle validation FAILED:\n  - ", paste(validation_errors, collapse = "\n  - "))

bundle <- list(
  decay_settings     = DECAY_SETTINGS,     # checked by downstream scripts
  spe_meta = data.frame(barcode = spe$barcode, sample_id = spe$sample_id,
                        NerveID = spe$NerveID, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  coords             = coords,
  plasma_score       = plasma_score,
  sham_shapes_df     = sham_shapes_df,
  nerve_info         = nerve_info,
  nerve_groups       = nerve_groups,
  decay_all          = decay_all,
  sham_decay_all     = sham_decay_all,     # one row per replicate
  paired_nerve       = paired_nerve,       # one row per real nerve, with own control
  paired_patient     = paired_patient,
  real_vs_sham       = real_vs_sham,       # step3 checks its plasma row against this
  GROUP_DEFS         = GROUP_DEFS,
  um_per_pixel       = um_per_pixel,
  per_nerve_dist_all = per_nerve_dist_all,
  per_shape_dist_all = per_shape_dist_all,
  out_dir            = out_dir
)
saveRDS(bundle, file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "figure_bundle_for_real_vs_relocated.rds"))
cat("Saved bundle (with decay settings, paired data and real_vs_sham).\n")
```

```{r distance_plot}
# ---- 10. 1-column, 3-row distance plot, ribbons = SE across patients --
# Can run standalone: reads the CSV written in section 8.
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

FIG_WIDTH_IN   <- 4
FIG_HEIGHT_IN  <- 9
FIG_DPI        <- 600
SIGNATURE_NAME <- "RCTD_PlasmaCells"

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
ANALYSIS_NAME <- "01_plasma_cells"
TABLES_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

plot_df <- read.csv(file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("averaged_curves_patient_level_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".csv"))) %>%
  mutate(Group  = factor(Group, levels = c("Invaded nerves (Diseased)",
                                           "Non-invaded nerves (Diseased)",
                                           "Non-invaded nerves (Adjacent)")),
         source = factor(source, levels = c("Real", "Sham")))

n_lab <- plot_df %>% group_by(Group) %>% summarise(n = max(n_patients), .groups = "drop")
strip_labels <- setNames(paste0(n_lab$Group, " (n = ", n_lab$n, " patients)"), n_lab$Group)

pal <- c(Real = "#1B4F8C", Sham = "grey50")
p_bw <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = bin, y = mean_across_patients, color = source, fill = source, group = source)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_across_patients - se, ymax = mean_across_patients + se), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +

  scale_color_manual(values = pal, labels = c(Real = "Real", Sham = "Geometry-matched control"), name = NULL) +

  facet_wrap(~ Group, ncol = 1, labeller = as_labeller(strip_labels)) +
  labs(x = "Distance from nerve (µm, binned)", y = "Mean proportion (± SE across patients)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))

print(p_bw)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("distance_curve_with_sham_BW_", SIGNATURE_NAME, ".pdf")),
       p_bw, width = FIG_WIDTH_IN, height = FIG_HEIGHT_IN, dpi = FIG_DPI)
```
